_summary: Scope: every .scss/.css under apps/web/src/ except styles/_tokens.scss (52 files). Comments excluded.
color: 0, spacing: 0, shadow: 0 (all 13 box-shadow declarations use --shadow-sm/--shadow-md), fontSize: 0, duration: 0 (no transitions/animations declared at all)
radius: 1, zIndex: 12, fontWeight: 3 literal + 2 references to an undefined token, lineHeight: 2, opacity: 18, breakpoints: 12, otherLength: 8, undefinedTokenReferences: 2

Total literal escapes: 58 (plus 2 undefined-token references). _tokens.scss defines no z-index, opacity, font-weight, line-height, breakpoint or duration tokens, so every value in those categories is necessarily literal.
undefinedTokenReferences: apps/web/src/app/features/projects/project-page-navigation.scss:37 font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium)  (token not defined anywhere; declaration is invalid at computed-value time)
lineHeight: apps/web/src/styles/_base.scss:19 line-height: 1.5  (file header states it holds no literals)
nearDuplicatePrimitives: Buttons: no shared button style exists (styles/_base.scss only resets font and color). Separate button rule sets in at least 19 files: app-shell.scss:75, archived-region.scss:85, insertion-point.scss:36, project-history-controls.scss:34, todos-page.scss:95, project-canvas.scss:135/149/170, project-header.scss:64, project-more-menu.scss:37/46, project-page-navigation.scss:24/127/208, project-workspace-shell.scss:95, section-create-dialog.scss:67/87, section-recovery-notice.scss:62, markdown-section-body.scss:4, markdown-source-editor.scss:22, reflection-composer.scss:22, project-section-frame.scss:36/80/127, task-list-section.scss:29/41, timeline-section.scss:3, shortcut-frame.scss:36/103, shortcut-picker.scss:33, work-create-dialog.scss:53/73, task-detail-drawer.scss:38, task-row.scss:64, sidebar.scss (.group__new, .create-project__submit). The Design Lab's .lab-button--primary/secondary/danger (primitive-panels.scss:14ff) is used by no product surface.

Templates that render <button> with no button rule in their own stylesheet (fall back to browser chrome): progress-section, reflections-section, reflection-composer (submit), todos-page (Complete), agent-connections-page (Revoke), archived-projects-page, timeline-section (row buttons get layout but no background/border reset).

Fields: input/select/textarea styled separately in 11 stylesheets (archived-region, section-create-dialog, markdown-source-editor, project-section-frame, task-list-section, work-create-dialog, task-detail-drawer, task-row, design-lab-page, primitive-panels, dev-panel-controls); templates with fields and no field rule: reflections-page, reflection-composer, reflections-section, progress-section, archived-projects-page, sidebar (new project input styled under a class), agent-connections-page and project-page-navigation (checkboxes).
Two near-identical dialog stylesheets: section-create-dialog.scss and work-create-dialog.scss each re-declare backdrop (z-index 20/-1, scrim 72%), panel shadow-md and button rules.
Two identical section-chrome stylesheets: project-section-frame.scss and shortcut-frame.scss re-declare controls row, remove button, not-allowed cursor and focus ring.
Visually-hidden helper duplicated in sidebar.scss:105ff and top-bar.scss:90ff.

Uppercase eyebrow label (font-size-sm, muted, uppercase, letter-spacing-wide) re-declared in sidebar.scss:53, activity-feed.scss:30, widget-content.scss:58, archived-region.scss:15, archive-page.scss:18, reflections-page.scss:29, project-header.scss:45, project-page-navigation.scss:222, agent-connections-page.scss:60, task-detail-drawer.scss:34, timeline-section.scss:4, panels.scss:36, dev-panel-controls.scss:19, dev-panel.scss:55, state-inspector-page.scss:24.

findings.surface: Token coverage gaps (code): stacking order, breakpoints, weights
findings.inventoryRow: Global shell; Section creation dialog; Workstream creation dialog; Section removal/recovery feedback; Global development dialog; responsive layouts
evidence: 12 literal z-index values forming an implicit ladder (1, 2, 10, 20, 30, 31, 40, 41) spread across 7 files — see tokenEscapes.zIndex. The recovery notice (10) sits below dialogs (20) and the phone drawer (30/31) by convention only.

12 literal breakpoints: 40rem (3 files), 42rem container (2), 48rem (3), 60rem (3), plus an 18rem Design Lab column — see tokenEscapes.breakpoints. Header, Todos and Reflections reflow at 40rem while the shell and canvas reflow at 48rem and the project column at 60rem.
Font weights: two literal 600s, one 'normal', two references to an undefined --font-weight-medium; _tokens.scss defines no weight scale.
repro: 1. Seed nested-projects as Demo User
2. Open /projects/project-kitchen
3. Resize the window between 1000px and 600px and watch header, canvas, project column and shell reflow at different widths
findings.expected: Layers, responsive thresholds and type weights behave as one system so surfaces change together.
findings.actual: These values live outside the token file and differ per component, so comparable surfaces reflow at different widths and layer order depends on per-file numbers.
